summary: Clear Set values while preserving live semantics for already-created iterators.

semantics.existing_iterators: skip cleared values and may observe subsequently appended values

caveats: Replacing the backing set wholesale can make suspended iterators incorrectly terminate.

tests.name: iterator observes post-clear add
tests.input: const s=new Set([1,2]); const it=s.values(); it.next(); s.clear(); s.add(3); console.log(it.next().value);
